name: gateway
label: Gateway
description: Manage the OpenClaw gateway — restart, read or update configuration, and trigger in-place updates.

raw.description: Full YAML/JSON config string for config.apply, or partial patch for config.patch

baseHash.description: Config hash for optimistic concurrency on config.apply

reason.description: Reason for the restart or update

note.description: Optional note attached to the operation

sessionKey.description: Session key for delivery context on restart

restartDelayMs.description: Delay before restart after config write

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the operation
